name: life-admin
description: Never miss a bill or renewal, see what's safe to spend, and plan a rainy-day pot. Everything stays on your computer.
long_description:
Life Admin keeps track of the everyday paperwork of life, and your assistant does the remembering.

- **Dates:** bills, renewals, insurance, MOT, council tax, subscriptions, warranties, passports, birthdays and appointments, with reminders in your own calendar.
- **Money:** import a bank statement to see where your money goes each week, what's due before payday, and how much you could comfortably put aside.
- **A calm home screen:** large text, plain words, and a Print button.
- **UK bank holidays** built in.

**Private:** your information is kept as plain files in a folder on this computer. Nothing is sent anywhere.

Try asking: *"Add my car insurance: £412 a year, renews 3 March."* or *"What's coming up this month?"* or *"Show me my home screen."*

It helps with budgeting sums on your own figures; it is not financial advice.

folder.title: Where to keep your life admin
folder.description: A folder on this computer for your bills, dates and spending. It's created for you if it doesn't exist. Most people can leave this as it is.

region.title: Where in the UK do you live?
region.description: Used for bank holidays. Type England, Wales, Scotland or Northern Ireland.
